driftAndNotes: No precheck drift: endpoint identity, port 8700, and all four config identities matched the OPS-001-g1 discovery receipt exactly.

Stack create is idempotent-verified: the first POST returned through a PowerShell client-side error, and the follow-up run found exactly one stack `rustwake` (id 125) and reconciled instead of creating a duplicate (stack count on endpoint 3 stayed 26).

Two config iterations inside the owned stack before the container went healthy: (1) `-g "pid ..."` duplicated the image's own `pid` directive -> `"pid" directive is duplicate`; fixed by shipping a dedicated main nginx.conf with a single `pid /tmp/nginx.pid`. (2) read-only rootfs + uid 101 -> `mkdir() "/var/cache/nginx/client_temp" failed (13)`; fixed by pointing the nginx temp areas at the /tmp tmpfs. Final state: user 101:101, read-only rootfs, 128 MB / 0.5 CPU limits.
Single-file bind mounts are inode-pinned: content edits require recreating the container (Portainer PUT with force=1), which was done.

Cosmetic, non-gating: two console 404s for /favicon.ico at the domain root (index.html declares no icon link and the root has no favicon route). Fix with a relative icon link or a favicon.ico in the release dir.

Cosmetic, non-gating: /assets/ responses carry two Cache-Control headers (nginx `expires 1y` plus the explicit `add_header`), i.e. `max-age=31536000` and `public, immutable`. Consolidate into one `add_header Cache-Control "public, max-age=31536000, immutable"` in a later static-config revision.
